scope.description: Observe a ReadIndex request delivered to a leader whose removal the application applied and whose reduced configuration has two voters, with CheckQuorum enabled: node 1 is elected in {1,2,3}, the application proposes and applies the committed removal of node 1 on all three nodes, six heartbeat rounds of node 1 are delivered and pumped, a read is delivered to node 1, and three further heartbeat rounds are delivered and pumped before the request's state is recorded.
assumptions: Three voters {1,2,3} with CheckQuorum enabled on every node and PreVote disabled; the election tick is 10 and the heartbeat tick is 1; node 1 is elected with a real MsgHup/MsgVote round.

The application applies the committed removal of node 1 on all three nodes, so node 1 keeps leading voters (2 3) under the default StepDownOnRemoval=false while the two remaining voters keep it as their leader.
No ticks are delivered to nodes 2 and 3, so their election timers do not expire and their leases stay in force; the receipt therefore measures the leaders' own rounds only.
excluded: PreVote, and lease-based reads (which force CheckQuorum but bypass the round).
Snapshots, asynchronous storage writes, and any state machine behind the read index.

basis.prefix: Elect node 1 in {1,2,3} with CheckQuorum enabled, apply the committed removal of node 1 on all three nodes, deliver three heartbeat rounds of node 1 and pump its messages, deliver MsgReadIndex to node 1 and read its emitted messages, deliver three more heartbeat rounds of node 1 and pump its messages, then record the request's fate and the state of all three nodes.
basis.requirement: A ReadIndex answer must let the application serve a linearizable read (raft.go:233-244 and README.md:27-32 state that ReadOnlySafe achieves linearizability by communicating with the quorum, and node.go:218-224 states that once the application advances past the returned read index, linearizable reads issued before the request can be processed safely). A leader that its own tracker shows is not in the configuration counts its own acknowledgement toward a round (raft.go:1600) whose quorum belongs to voters it is not one of, so the receipt records whether such a request is answered and whether the configuration replaces the leader at all.
basis.responsibility: raft (target): the MsgReadIndex path decides whether a leader that is not in its own configuration takes the request into a read-only round and which acknowledgements that round counts, and the lease path decides whether the remaining voters ever elect a replacement.

comparisons.description: Premise: after the removal node 1 still leads a configuration of two voters, so the singleton shortcut cannot decide this request.
Premise: three heartbeat rounds pass and the two remaining voters elect no replacement - they still answer the removed leader and their leases keep them from voting.
Premise: the removed leader takes the request into readOnly.unconfirmedReads and broadcasts its heartbeats.
Premise: after three further rounds the removed leader is still the leader at its own term, so nothing in this configuration ends its lease.

Witness: the request is answered even though the answering node is not a voter of the configuration whose quorum the round needed - the round counted the removed leader's own acknowledgement, and no replacement leader exists to end the state.
